messages:
Maria (Finance): Hey team — Stratify Systems sent invoice INV-2026-317 but the OCRed PDF didn't capture the PO field so our AP system flagged it as 'no PO'. Due date 2026-03-12. PDF: https://files.redwood.internal/invoices/INV-2026-317.pdf Can procurement confirm the PO number and who should approve? Need to get this into the queue today.
Kate (AP): Thanks — can you paste the vendor invoice total and invoice date? I can hold payment till we have PO/approver but want to avoid late fees.
Maria (Finance): Total $18,450.00, invoice date 2026-02-28. Scanned copy has a bad bottom margin — looks like PO line got cropped.
Kate (AP): Got it. I tried a manual lookup in AP — no PO matched to that invoice number. approvals-bot returned: "no matching PO found" :eyes:
Approvals Bot: No purchase order linked for vendor 'Stratify Systems' / invoice INV-2026-317. Recommend add PO to invoice metadata or attach vendor remittance showing PO.
Ryan (Procurement): Jumping in — working from the order history. There is a PO: PO-4521-PL raised 2026-02-15 for Stratify (same amount/qty). It was earmarked for Nate (Ops) to approve but looks like it never routed after vendor change. @Nate can you confirm approval? GL should be 5102 (Cloud infra services).
Nate (Ops): I see PO-4521-PL in the catalog. I had reviewed the estimate but never hit final approve — my bad, got pulled into the launch. Happy to approve now if everything else lines up. Can AP re-upload a cleaned invoice with PO visible so workflow picks it up?
Kate (AP): Will do. Maria — can you re-upload a higher-res PDF or just a cropped screenshot that includes the PO line? If you want, I can paste PO into the invoice metadata field so approvals-bot can proceed.
Maria (Finance): Uploaded new scan here: https://files.redwood.internal/invoices/INV-2026-317-scanned.pdf I also added a short comment: "PO-4521-PL" in the metadata. Please try the workflow again.
Approvals Bot: New file detected for INV-2026-317. PO matched: PO-4521-PL. Routing to approver Nate (Ops).
Nate (Ops): Reviewed and approved PO-4521-PL. :thumbsup: Note: GL 5102, cost center ENG-ML. Please proceed to payment batch.
Kate (AP): Marking invoice ready for payment in AP queue. Payment scheduled next run 2026-03-10. Thanks everyone.
Maria (Finance): Great — closing the loop. Let me know if payment hits any issues. :white_check_mark:
notes: OCR crop -> manual metadata fix -> approver routed -> approval -> payment scheduled
